questions.question: During King Hezekiah's reign, what did the Israelites do throughout the cities of Judah?

answers.text: Smashed the sacred pillars and tore down the high places
Built new altars on every hilltop
Read the Law aloud at every city gate

questions.question: In King Hezekiah's time, who paid for the regular morning, evening and Sabbath burnt offerings?

answers.text: The king from his own possessions
The priests from their own flocks
The officials from the city treasury

questions.question: Why did King Hezekiah command the people of Jerusalem to give a contribution to the priests and Levites?

answers.text: So they could devote themselves to the Law of the LORD
So they could repair the house of the LORD
So they could rebuild the walls of Jerusalem
